snippet.title: Filly Fantasy VI - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
From DrakeyC, RydelFox, and a host of other contributors, comes Final Fantasy VI like you've never played it before. Prepare for a war spanning a thousand years against King Sombra and Discord as they seek to enslave the Espers and plunge Equestria into chaos.

Visit the group on Fimfiction.net for more details.

http://www.fimfiction.net/group/209828/filly-fantasy-vi
